instruction: Look at valve_body.dxf. Draw the 160 x 70 valve body as a rectangle on layer OUTLINE with corners at (0,0), (160,0), (160,70), and (0,70). Add radius 12 smooth through port circles at (30,35) and (130,35) on layer HOLE. Add four radius 4 smooth through bolt-hole circles at (20,15), (20,55), (140,15), and (140,55) on layer HOLE; do not draw thread pitch, thread depth, or other thread details. Add a CENTER line from (0,35) to (160,35), and add text ACAD-15 on layer ANNOTATION. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
